description: This header file declares inline functions related to the 'fsmonitor' feature in a version control system, likely Git. It provides functions to check if the filesystem monitor has been refreshed, mark cache entries as valid or invalid concerning the fsmonitor, and manage related cache states.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks whether the fsmonitor feature has been initialized and run at least once. Returns true if the mode indicates disabled or the monitor has been run once.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid for fsmonitor if the feature is enabled and the cache entry isn't a submodule. Updates the cache change status.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entry's fsmonitor validity and triggers untracked cache invalidation for the path.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
